description: Exemplary: warm, fully specific on charges, all closing elements

transcript.content: Good morning Ravi, this is Anjali from HDFC Bank, calling about the business loan enquiry you submitted yesterday.
Hi. Honestly I'm scared there will be charges I don't know about.

That's a very fair worry, Ravi, especially for a first loan. The rate is 13% per annum, there's a one-time processing fee of 1.5%, and if an EMI is late beyond a 3-day grace period, the penalty is 2% of the EMI amount.
What if I want to close the loan early?
After 6 EMIs you can foreclose with zero foreclosure charges.
Okay, that helps. What next?
You'll need your Aadhaar, PAN and last 6 months of bank statements. If you're comfortable, I'll WhatsApp you the upload link now and call you tomorrow at 11 to check if you need help.

label_notes.closing: Docs + WhatsApp link/callback time + 'if you're comfortable' = 3/3.
